#NOTE: This script relies on restricted-access SNIS, survey, and sensor data, which are not included in the repository. Users with appropriate access should place these files in the data/ subdirectories following the documented structure.

```{r libs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(zoo)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# Project paths (relative to repository root)
# ============================================================

library(here)

# Ensure knitting always runs from repo root
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

code_dir    <- here("code")
data_dir    <- here("data")
sensor_dir  <- here("data", "sensor")
snis_dir    <- here("data", "snis")
survey_dir  <- here("data", "survey")

output_dir  <- here("output")
temp_dir    <- here("output", "temp")

dir.create(temp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

```

## Read in data

```{r data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
snis_filepath <- file.path(
  snis_dir,
  "SNIS_NK_HK_SK_2025.xls"
)

if (!file.exists(snis_filepath)) {
  stop("SNIS data file not found. Expected in data/snis/.")
}

# Import variable labels 
var_labels <- read_excel(snis_filepath, range = "A1:HK1", col_names = FALSE)
col_labels_vec <- as.character(var_labels[1, ])
col_types_vec <- rep("numeric", length(col_labels_vec))

# Specify which to read in as characters (everything else is numeric)
period_col <- which(col_labels_vec == "periodname")
orgunit_col <- which(col_labels_vec == "organisationunitname")
col_types_vec[c(period_col, orgunit_col)] <- "text"

# Import data
snis_RAW <- read_excel(snis_filepath, skip = 1, col_types = col_types_vec)

# Assign column names
colnames(snis_RAW) <- col_labels_vec

```

# Create date, province, facility type, and numeric ID variables
```{r tags, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# French to English month mapping
month_mapping <- c(
  "Janvier" = "January", "Février" = "February", "Mars" = "March",
  "Avril" = "April", "Mai" = "May", "Juin" = "June",
  "Juillet" = "July", "Août" = "August", "Septembre" = "September",
  "Octobre" = "October", "Novembre" = "November", "Décembre" = "December"
)

# Replace French month names
for (french_month in names(month_mapping)) {
  snis_RAW$periodname <- str_replace_all(snis_RAW$periodname, french_month, month_mapping[[french_month]])
}

# Convert to yearmon
snis_RAW$month <- as.yearmon(snis_RAW$periodname, format = "%B %Y") #yearmon object

snis_RAW$month_date <- as.Date(snis_RAW$month) #date object

# Create variable for province name
snis_RAW <- snis_RAW %>%
  mutate(
    province = case_when(
      str_sub(organisationunitname, 1, 2) == "hk" ~ "Haut Katanga",
      str_sub(organisationunitname, 1, 2) == "sk" ~ "South Kivu",
      str_sub(organisationunitname, 1, 2) == "nk" ~ "North Kivu",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Create variable for facility type
snis_RAW <- snis_RAW %>%
  mutate(
    facilitytype = case_when(
      str_detect(organisationunitname, fixed("Hôpital Général de Référence", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "HGR",
      str_detect(organisationunitname, fixed("Hôpital Provincial de Référence", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PH",
      str_detect(organisationunitname, fixed("Centre de Santé de Référence", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CSR",
      str_detect(organisationunitname, fixed("Centre Hospitalier", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CH",
      str_detect(organisationunitname, fixed("Centre Médical", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CM",
      str_detect(organisationunitname, fixed("Hôpital", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "H",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


sum(is.na(snis_RAW$facilitytype)) #These should not have downloaded - remove them
snis_RAW %>%
  filter(is.na(facilitytype)) %>%
  select(organisationunitname) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  head(50)

snis_RAW <- snis_RAW %>%
  filter(!is.na(facilitytype))

# Create unique ID
snis_RAW <- snis_RAW %>%
  mutate(id = as.numeric(factor(str_trim(organisationunitname))))

snis_RAW %>%
  distinct(id, province, facilitytype) %>%
  count(province, facilitytype)
```

# Clean up missing values
```{r zeros, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
# 1. Remove J 9.6 variables
snis_cleaned <- snis_RAW %>%
  select(-starts_with("J 9.6"))

# 2. Identify numeric variables (excluding metadata)
numeric_vars <- snis_cleaned %>%
  select(-periodname, -organisationunitname, -id) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  colnames()

# 3. Replace NA with 0 for specified variables
vars_to_zero <- snis_cleaned %>%
  select(
    starts_with("D 8.2"), starts_with("D 9.6"),
    starts_with("D 11.1"), starts_with("D 11.2"),
    starts_with("D 2.4"),
    "A 2.3 Mort-nés frais",
    "A 2.3 Mort-nés macérés", 
    "A 2.3 Accouchées avec complications obstétricales",
    "A 2.3 Accouchées référées l'HGR",
    "A 2.4 Décès nouveaux-nés ≤ 28 jours"
  ) %>%
  colnames()

snis_cleaned <- snis_cleaned %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_zero), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))


# 4.: Create new variables with facility-level averages, preserving originals

snis_cleaned <- snis_cleaned %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    bedcount = if (all(is.na(`D 8.1 Nombre des lits montés`))) NA_real_ else mean(`D 8.1 Nombre des lits montés`, na.rm = TRUE),
    nursecount_A1 = if (all(is.na(`A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Agents`))) NA_real_ else mean(`A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Agents`, na.rm = TRUE),
    nursecount_A2 = if (all(is.na(`A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Agents`))) NA_real_ else mean(`A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Agents`, na.rm = TRUE),
    doctorcount = if (all(is.na(`A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Agents`))) NA_real_ else mean(`A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Agents`, na.rm = TRUE),
    labtechcount = if (all(is.na(`A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - agents`))) NA_real_ else mean(`A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - agents`, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 5.: Imputation for certain variables 

impute_vars <- c(
  "A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Jours de travail préstés", "A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Jours de travail prévus",
  "A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Jours de travail préstés", "A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Jours de travail prévus",
  "A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Jours de travail préstés", "A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Jours de travail prévus",
  "A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - travail preste", "A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - travail prevu",
  grep("^A 1.2.1", names(snis_cleaned), value = TRUE),
  "A 1.3 Nouveaux cas femmes enceintes", 
  "A 2.3 Accouchements", "A 2.3 Accouchements par personnel qualifié", 
  "A 2.3 Naissances vivantes",
  grep("^D 8.1", names(snis_cleaned), value = TRUE),
  grep("^D 8.2", names(snis_cleaned), value = TRUE)
)

snis_cleaned <- snis_cleaned %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(impute_vars), 
                ~ if (all(is.na(.))) NA_real_ else ifelse(is.na(.), mean(., na.rm = TRUE), .))) %>%
  ungroup()

# 6.: Deal with remaining D 6.2 and D 6.3 vars (only relevant for hospitals)

impute_vars <- c(
  "D 6.2 Nouveaux cas vus aux urgences",
  "D 6.3 Cas Référé par le CS",
  "D 6.3 Consultations Hospitalisés"
)

zero_replace_vars <- c(
  "D 6.2 Nouveaux cas vus aux urgences Détresse respiratoire",
  "D 6.2 Décès aux urgences"
)

all_d62_d63_vars <- c(impute_vars, zero_replace_vars)
relevant_types <- c("CH", "H", "HGR", "PH")

snis_cleaned <- snis_cleaned %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(all_d62_d63_vars), 
                ~ case_when(
                  !facilitytype %in% relevant_types ~ NA_real_,
                  cur_column() %in% impute_vars ~ if (all(is.na(.))) NA_real_ else ifelse(is.na(.), mean(., na.rm = TRUE), .),
                  cur_column() %in% zero_replace_vars ~ if (all(is.na(.))) NA_real_ else ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .),
                  TRUE ~ .
                ))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Create outcome variables
```{r varcreation, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}
snis_cleaned <- snis_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    # Patient counts
    outpatientcount = rowSums(select(., starts_with("A 1.2.1")), na.rm = TRUE),
    inpatientcount_active = rowSums(select(., contains("Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois")), na.rm = TRUE),
    inpatientcount_new = rowSums(select(., contains("Malades admis au cours du mois")), na.rm = TRUE),
    inpatientcount_complete = rowSums(select(., contains("Sortants du mois")), na.rm = TRUE),

    # Death totals
    totaldeaths_9.6 = rowSums(select(., starts_with("D 9.6")), na.rm = TRUE),
    totaldeaths_8.2 = rowSums(select(., contains("Issues des hospitalisés-Décès")), na.rm = TRUE),

    # Discrepancy and mortality rates
    deathdiscrepancy = totaldeaths_9.6 - totaldeaths_8.2,
   mortrate_active = ifelse(
  inpatientcount_active > 0 & (totaldeaths_8.2 / inpatientcount_active)*100 <= 60, 
  (totaldeaths_8.2 / inpatientcount_active)*100, 
  NA_real_
),
mortrate_complete = ifelse(
  inpatientcount_complete > 0 & (totaldeaths_8.2 / inpatientcount_complete)*100 <= 60, 
  (totaldeaths_8.2 / inpatientcount_complete)*100, 
  NA_real_
),
mortrate_new = ifelse(
  inpatientcount_new > 0 & (totaldeaths_8.2 / inpatientcount_new)*100 <= 60,
  (totaldeaths_8.2 / inpatientcount_new)*100,
  NA_real_
),

    #Mortality rates by ward
    surgicaldeaths = rowSums(select(., `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Chirurgie`, `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Chirurgie`), na.rm = TRUE),
    obgyndeaths = rowSums(select(., `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Gyn. Obst`, `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Gyn. Obst`), na.rm = TRUE),
    pedsdeaths = rowSums(select(., `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Pédiatrie`, `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Pédiatrie`), na.rm = TRUE),
    internalmeddeaths = rowSums(select(., `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Méd. Interne`, `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Méd. Interne`), na.rm = TRUE),
    resuscitationdeaths = rowSums(select(., `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Réanimation Urgence`, `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Réanimation Urgence`), na.rm = TRUE),
    specialitydeaths = rowSums(select(., `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Spécialité`, `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Spécialité`), na.rm = TRUE),

    mortrate_surgical = ifelse(`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Chirurgie` > 0 & (surgicaldeaths /`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Chirurgie`)*100 <= 75, 
  (surgicaldeaths / `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Chirurgie`)*100, 
  NA_real_
    ),
    mortrate_obgyn = ifelse(`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Gyn. Obst` > 0 & (obgyndeaths /`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Gyn. Obst`)*100 <= 75, 
  (obgyndeaths / `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Gyn. Obst`)*100, 
  NA_real_
    ), 
    mortrate_peds = ifelse(`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Pédiatrie` > 0 & (pedsdeaths /`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Pédiatrie`)*100 <= 75, 
  (pedsdeaths / `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Pédiatrie`)*100, 
  NA_real_
    ), 
    mortrate_internalmed = ifelse(`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Méd. Interne` > 0 & (internalmeddeaths /`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Méd. Interne`)*100 <= 75, 
  (internalmeddeaths / `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Méd. Interne`)*100, 
  NA_real_
    ), 
    mortrate_resuscitation = ifelse(`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Réanimation Urgence` > 0 & (resuscitationdeaths /`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Réanimation Urgence`)*100 <= 75, 
  (resuscitationdeaths / `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Réanimation Urgence`)*100, 
  NA_real_
    ), 
    mortrate_specialty = ifelse(`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Spécialité` > 0 & (specialitydeaths /`D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Spécialité`)*100 <= 75, 
  (specialitydeaths / `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Spécialité`)*100, 
  NA_real_
    ), 

    # Patient counts
    surgical_count     = `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Chirurgie`,
    obgyn_count        = `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Gyn. Obst`,
    peds_count         = `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Pédiatrie`,
    internalmed_count  = `D 8.1 Malades en hospitalisation au début du mois Méd. Interne`,

    # Delivery outcomes
    livebirths = `A 2.3 Naissances vivantes`,
    deliveries = `A 2.3 Accouchements`,
    stillbirths = `A 2.3 Mort-nés frais` + `A 2.3 Mort-nés macérés`,
    maternalmort = ifelse(deliveries > 0, (`A 2.4 Décès maternels` / deliveries)*100, NA_real_),
    neonatalmort = ifelse(deliveries > 0, (`A 2.4 Décès nouveaux-nés ≤ 28 jours` / deliveries)*100, NA_real_),

    # Staffing
    nurse_A1 = `A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Jours de travail prévus`,
    nurse_A2 = `A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Jours de travail prévus`,
    doctor = `A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Jours de travail prévus`,
    labtech = `A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - travail prevu`, 

    # Staff attendance rates
    nurse_A1_attendrate = ifelse(
      `A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Jours de travail prévus` > 0,
      (`A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Jours de travail préstés` /
      `A 4.7 Infirmier A1 Jours de travail prévus`),
     NA_real_
    ),
        nurse_A2_attendrate = ifelse(
      `A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Jours de travail prévus` > 0,
      `A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Jours de travail préstés` /
        `A 4.7 Infirmier A2 Jours de travail prévus`,
      NA_real_
    ),
    doctor_attendrate = ifelse(
      `A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Jours de travail prévus` > 0,
      `A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Jours de travail préstés` /
        `A 4.7 Médecin généraliste Jours de travail prévus`,
      NA_real_
    ),
    labtech_attendrate = ifelse(
      `A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - travail prevu` > 0,
      `A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - travail preste` /
        `A 4.7 Technicien de labo A2/A1/L2 - travail prevu`,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Surgical mortality rate
    surgmortrate = ifelse(
  (`D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Chirurgie` + `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Chirurgie`) > 0,
  ((`D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Sortants du mois dont (b) Chirurgie`) /
    (`D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès avant 48 h Chirurgie` + `D 8.2 Issues des hospitalisés-Décès après 48 h Chirurgie`))*100,
  NA_real_
),

    # Respiratory emergency mortality rate
    respemerg_mortrate = ifelse(
      `D 6.2 Nouveaux cas vus aux urgences Détresse respiratoire` > 0,
      (`D 6.2 Décès aux urgences`/`D 6.2 Nouveaux cas vus aux urgences Détresse respiratoire`)*100,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Referrals received (renamed)
    referralsreceived = `D 6.3 Cas Référé par le CS`
  )


snis_analytical <- snis_cleaned %>%
  select(
    id, organisationunitname, facilitytype, province, month, month_date,
    
    bedcount, nursecount_A1, nursecount_A2, doctorcount, labtechcount,
    
    outpatientcount, inpatientcount_active, inpatientcount_complete, totaldeaths_9.6, totaldeaths_8.2, deathdiscrepancy,
    mortrate_active, mortrate_complete, mortrate_new, livebirths, deliveries, stillbirths,
    maternalmort, neonatalmort,
    mortrate_surgical, mortrate_obgyn, mortrate_peds, mortrate_internalmed, mortrate_resuscitation, mortrate_specialty,
    nurse_A1_attendrate, nurse_A2_attendrate, doctor_attendrate, labtech_attendrate,
    surgmortrate, respemerg_mortrate,
    referralsreceived, surgicaldeaths, obgyndeaths, pedsdeaths, internalmeddeaths, surgical_count, obgyn_count, peds_count, internalmed_count, nurse_A1, nurse_A2, doctor, labtech
  )



facilities_all_zero_df <- snis_analytical %>%
  filter(!is.na(mortrate_active)) %>%
  group_by(id, facilitytype) %>%
  summarise(all_zero = all(mortrate_active == 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(all_zero) %>%
  count(facilitytype, name = "facilities_all_zero")

facilities_all_missing_df <- snis_analytical %>%
  group_by(id, facilitytype) %>%
  summarise(all_missing = all(is.na(mortrate_active)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(all_missing) %>%
  count(facilitytype, name = "facilities_all_missing")

facility_counts_df <- snis_analytical %>%
  distinct(id, facilitytype) %>%
  count(facilitytype, name = "total_facilities")

# Main summary table
summary_table <- snis_analytical %>%
  group_by(facilitytype) %>%
  summarise(
    zero_values = sum(mortrate_active == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_count = round(mean(totaldeaths_8.2, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_rate = round(mean(mortrate_active, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median = round(median(mortrate_active, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min = round(min(mortrate_active, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max = round(max(mortrate_active, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd = round(sd(mortrate_active, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(facilities_all_zero_df, by = "facilitytype") %>%
  left_join(facilities_all_missing_df, by = "facilitytype") %>%
  left_join(facility_counts_df, by = "facilitytype") %>%
  replace_na(list(facilities_all_zero = 0,
                  facilities_all_missing = 0,
                  total_facilities = 0)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_rate))


##

  group_by(id, facilitytype) %>%
  summarise(all_zero = all(mortrate_complete == 0), .groups = "drop") %>%

facilities_all_missing_df2 <- snis_analytical %>%

zero_mort_ids_snis <- snis_analytical %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(all_zero = all(mortrate_active == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(all_zero) %>%
  pull(id)

zero_mort_facilities_snis <- snis_analytical %>%
  filter(id %in% zero_mort_ids_snis) %>%
  select(id, organisationunitname, facilitytype, province) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)




```



# Merge with survey data
```{r merge, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE}

survey_filepath2 <- file.path(
  survey_dir,
  "Survey.xlsx"
)

survey_labels2 <- read_excel(survey_filepath2, range = "A1:DQ1", col_names = FALSE)  
survey_col_labels2 <- as.character(survey_labels2[1, ])

survey <- read_excel(survey_filepath2, skip = 1, col_types = "text")
colnames(survey) <- survey_col_labels2

# Fix how the dates are read in
survey <- survey %>%
  mutate(across(
    ends_with("_date"),
    ~ as.Date(as.numeric(.x), origin = "1899-12-30")
  ))

# Make vars numeric that should be
survey <- survey %>%
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ if (all(is.na(.x) | grepl("^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$", .x))) as.numeric(.x) else .x
  ))

survey_unique <- survey %>%
  distinct(organisationunitname, .keep_all = TRUE)

snis_analytical_tmle2 <- snis_analytical %>%
  left_join(survey_unique, by = "organisationunitname")

saveRDS(
  snis_analytical_tmle2,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "snis_analytical_FINAL.rds")
)

```
